system.description:
A mundane, but nevertheless potent and reliable offensive spell for the common mage.

Gain 1 additional use of this spell per unit Level.

A frigid bolt of ice and sleet that shatters an opponent's Stance.

Gain 1 additional use of this spell per unit Level.
Protected from Fire and Arcane damage. Vulnerable to Missile damage.

Bolster your defenses with magic, gaining up to 10 Shield points. This spell will not increase your Shield past 10 points. (Shield points are temporary HP that absorb damage dealt to the unit. If all damage from an attack or effect is absorbed, any Stance damage that would normally accompany the attack or effect is negated.)
